method: Each Eye Trends service, product and utility page (from the Eye Trends content inventory) is checked against Academy Vision text extracted from audit/raw. YES = the service is named in Academy Vision visible copy; PARTIAL = only part of it, or only an adjacent service, is evidenced; NO = no Academy Vision text evidences it. Every quote is verbatim and was located in the cited page on the cited surface.

conflicts.detail: (732) 978-9306 is the number in the header text, footer, every Call button, the accessibility policy and the newer JSON-LD. (732) 736-1700 is dialled by the header phone icon (aria-label Call Us) on all 31 pages, shown on two buttons on /eye-care-services/, used in the /sitemap/ meta description, and in the older JSON-LD blocks on every page. Measured on the saved home page (tmp/facts/icon-check.json): at 1280 px the header shows the Call: (732) 978-9306 button and hides the icon; at 768 px and 390 px it hides that button and shows only the icon, so a tablet or phone visitor who taps the header call control dials (732) 736-1700.
